Also known as: ACV SaaS; Average Annual Contract Value
Definition: The average yearly value of a customer contract, with one-off fees left out.

Also known as: ARR Growth; ARR Growth Rate
Definition: How much annual recurring revenue has grown compared with an earlier period.

Also known as: New Business ARR; New Logo ARR; New MRR
Definition: The recurring revenue added from customers who signed up for the first time in a period.

Also known as: Net New MRR; Net New Recurring Revenue
Definition: The recurring revenue added in a period after taking away what was lost to cancellations and downgrades.

Also known as: Monthly Churn; Annual Churn; Subscription Churn Rate
Definition: The share of subscribers or accounts lost in a period.

Also known as: Rule of Forty
Definition: A rule of thumb for software firms: the growth rate plus the profit margin should add up to at least 40%.

Also known as: Magic Number; Sales Efficiency Magic Number
Definition: A measure of how much recurring revenue is gained for each unit of sales and marketing spend in the previous period.

Also known as: Monthly Burn; Cash Burn; Net Burn
Definition: The amount of cash the business spends more than it earns each month.

Also known as: Cash Runway; Months of Runway
Definition: The number of months the business can keep going at the current burn rate before the cash runs out.

Also known as: Subscription Gross Margin; Software Gross Margin
Definition: The share of revenue left after the direct cost of delivering the service, such as hosting and support.

Also known as: Cost of Revenue; Hosting Cost
Definition: The cost of running and supporting the service for customers, including hosting, support and licences.

Also known as: Cloud Cost; Cloud Bill; Infrastructure Spend
Definition: The money spent on cloud services such as servers, storage and databases.

Also known as: Infrastructure Cost per Customer; Hosting Cost per User; Cost per Active User
Definition: The cloud cost divided by the number of customers or active users.

Also known as: Resource Utilisation; CPU Utilisation; Server Utilisation
Definition: The share of the available computing capacity, such as processor or memory, that is in use.

Also known as: Service Availability; Service Uptime
Definition: The share of time that a system or service is working and can be used.

Also known as: SLO; SLO Attainment; SLO Compliance
Definition: An internal target for how well a service should perform, such as 99.9% availability, and how often it is met.

Also known as: SLA Uptime; Contractual Uptime; SLA Compliance Uptime
Definition: The availability promised to customers in the service agreement, and whether it was achieved.

Also known as: Failure Rate; Request Error Rate; Error Percentage
Definition: The share of requests or operations that ended in an error.

Also known as: Latency; Page Load Time; API Response Time
Definition: The time taken for a system to answer a request.

Also known as: Requests per Second; Transactions per Second; TPS
Definition: The number of requests or transactions a system handles per second.

Also known as: MTTD; Time to Detect
Definition: The average time between a problem starting and the team noticing it.

Also known as: MTTR Incident; Mean Time to Restore; Mean Time to Resolve Incident
Definition: The average time taken to restore service after an incident.

Also known as: MTBI; Time Between Incidents
Definition: The average time that passes between one incident and the next.

Also known as: P1 Incidents; Service Incidents
Definition: The number of service disruptions or incidents in a period, often split by how serious they were.

Also known as: Failed Changes; Failed Deployments; Deployment Failure Rate
Definition: The share of changes or releases that caused a failure and needed a fix or a roll-back.

Also known as: Release Frequency; Deployments per Week; Release Cadence
Definition: How often new versions of software are released to production.

Also known as: Change Lead Time; Commit to Deploy Time; Cycle Time Software
Definition: The time taken for a code change to go from being written to running in production.

Also known as: Velocity; Story Points per Sprint; Team Velocity
Definition: The amount of work, usually measured in story points, that a development team completes in each sprint.

Also known as: Sprint Completion Rate; Sprint Predictability; Committed vs Delivered
Definition: The share of the work planned for a sprint that was actually finished.

Also known as: Product Backlog; Open Backlog Items; Backlog Count
Definition: The number of work items waiting to be done in the product backlog.

Also known as: Open Bugs; Defects Open; Bugs Reported
Definition: The number of known software faults that have not yet been fixed.

Also known as: Time to Fix; Bug Resolution Time; Defect Resolution Time
Definition: The average time taken to fix a software fault from when it was reported.

Also known as: Bugs per Thousand Lines; Defects per KLOC; Bug Density
Definition: The number of defects found for each thousand lines of code, or for each unit of software size.

Also known as: Test Coverage; Unit Test Coverage
Definition: The share of the code that is run by automated tests.

Also known as: Automated Test Pass Rate; Build Success Rate; Test Success Rate
Definition: The share of automated tests that passed in a run.

Also known as: Tech Debt; Technical Debt Ratio; Code Debt
Definition: The extra work that builds up when quick fixes are chosen instead of better solutions, and which must be paid back later.

Also known as: Open Vulnerabilities; Critical Vulnerabilities; Vulnerability Count
Definition: The number of known security weaknesses in systems or software that have not yet been fixed.

Also known as: Patch Time; Time to Remediate; Vulnerability Remediation Time
Definition: The average time taken to fix a security weakness after it was found.

Also known as: Patching Compliance; Patched Systems; Patch Coverage
Definition: The share of systems that have the latest security updates installed.

Also known as: Security Breaches; Cyber Incidents; Data Breaches
Definition: The number of events in which security was breached or threatened.

Also known as: Phishing Failure Rate; Phish-Prone Percentage; Phishing Simulation Click Rate
Definition: The share of staff who clicked a link in a test phishing email.

Also known as: User Access Review Completion; Access Recertification; Access Review Rate
Definition: The share of planned reviews of who has access to which systems that were completed.

Also known as: Backup Completion; Successful Backups; Backup Compliance
Definition: The share of planned backups that finished successfully.

Also known as: RTO; Recovery Time; Disaster Recovery Time
Definition: The target for how quickly a system must be working again after a failure.

Also known as: RPO; Data Loss Window
Definition: The longest period of data loss that the business can accept after a failure, such as one hour of data.

Also known as: Help Desk Tickets; IT Tickets; Service Desk Volume
Definition: The number of requests for help received by the IT service desk.

Also known as: IT Resolution Time; Time to Resolve IT Ticket; Service Desk Resolution Time
Definition: The average time taken for the IT service desk to close a ticket.

Also known as: Service Desk First Contact Resolution; IT FCR
Definition: The share of IT requests that were solved at the first contact.

Also known as: IT Spend to Revenue; IT Cost Ratio; Technology Spend Ratio
Definition: The money spent on IT shown as a percentage of revenue.

Also known as: IT Project On-Time Delivery; Projects On Schedule; Schedule Performance Technology
Definition: The share of IT projects delivered by their planned date.

Also known as: Licence Usage; License Utilization; Unused Licences; Shelfware
Definition: The share of bought software licences that are in use. Unused licences are wasted money.

Also known as: Tool Adoption; User Adoption; Software Adoption Rate
Definition: The share of intended users who actively use a new application.

Also known as: NDR SaaS; Dollar-Based Net Retention
Definition: The recurring revenue from existing customers a year later, including upgrades and losses, compared with the start of the period.

Also known as: Cost per Ticket; Support Cost per Ticket
Definition: The cost of running the support team divided by the number of tickets handled.

Also known as: Feature Usage Rate; Feature Engagement; Feature Utilisation
Definition: The share of users who use a given feature in a period.

Also known as: API Requests; API Usage; API Call Volume
Definition: The number of times other programs called the product's interface in a period.

Also known as: Data Processed; Data Ingested; Storage Used
Definition: The amount of data stored or handled by the system in a period.

Also known as: Live Subscriptions; Paying Subscriptions; Active Licences
Definition: The number of subscriptions that are currently live and paid for.

Also known as: Seats Added; Licence Expansion; Seat Growth
Definition: The growth in the number of user seats bought by existing customers.
